title: 咘咘上幼儿园的第一天

pages.text: 今天是个大日子！咘咘穿上最喜欢的粉裙子，背上小书包，站在镜子前面左看右看。「我今天要去幼儿园啦！」
pages.text_en: Today is a big day! Bubu puts on her favorite pink dress, picks up her little backpack, and checks herself in the mirror. "I'm going to school today!"

pages.text: 全家人都来送咘咘上幼儿园！爸爸牵着咘咘的一只手，妈妈牵着另一只手，外公外婆走在后面，一路上说说笑笑。
pages.text_en: The whole family comes to see Bubu off! Dad holds one hand, Mom holds the other, while Grandpa and Grandma walk behind them, chatting and laughing.

pages.text: 到了幼儿园门口，咘咘看着大大的彩色门，突然紧紧抓住妈妈的手不想松开。「妈妈……里面有好多不认识的人。」
pages.text_en: At the school gate, Bubu looks at the big colorful entrance and suddenly grips Mom's hand tightly. "Mommy... there are so many people I don't know in there."

pages.text: NOMI 蹲下来，温柔地摸摸咘咘的头：「我们会在家等你回来哦！」Coco 拍拍小翅膀——不对，Coco 挥挥小爪子说：「You can do it, Bubu! Be brave!」
pages.text_en: NOMI kneels down and gently pats Bubu's head: "We'll be waiting for you at home!" Coco waves her little paws: "You can do it, Bubu! Be brave!"

pages.text: 一只温柔的橘猫老师走出来，笑眯眯地蹲下来说：「你好呀小朋友，我是喵喵老师，欢迎你来我们班！」咘咘偷偷抬头看了一眼，老师的笑容好温暖。
pages.text_en: A gentle orange tabby cat teacher comes out, kneels down with a warm smile: "Hello little one, I'm Teacher Miao. Welcome to our class!" Bubu peeks up — the teacher's smile is so warm.

pages.text: 教室里好多小朋友在玩！咘咘站在门口不太敢进去。这时候一只小鹿走过来：「你要一起搭积木吗？我搭了一个城堡！」
pages.text_en: The classroom is full of little friends playing! Bubu stands at the door, a bit shy. Then a little deer walks over: "Want to build blocks with me? I made a castle!"

pages.text: 不一会儿，咘咘就玩得忘了紧张。她和新朋友一起画画、唱歌、跳舞，教室里到处都是笑声。
pages.text_en: Before long, Bubu forgets all her nervousness. She paints, sings, and dances with her new friends. The classroom is filled with laughter.

pages.text: 午饭时间到了！小朋友们排排坐，每个人面前都有一碗香喷喷的饭菜。咘咘吃得好开心，还跟旁边的小朋友说：「这个胡萝卜好甜！」
pages.text_en: Lunchtime! The little ones sit in a row, each with a bowl of yummy food. Bubu eats happily and tells her neighbor: "This carrot is so sweet!"

pages.text: 午睡时间到了。所有小朋友都闭上眼睛睡着了，只有咘咘的眼睛睁得大大的，怎么也睡不着。天花板上有一只小蜻蜓在飞……
pages.text_en: Nap time. All the little friends close their eyes and fall asleep, but Bubu's eyes stay wide open. She just can't sleep. A little dragonfly dances on the ceiling...

pages.text: 喵喵老师轻轻走过来，坐在咘咘旁边，温柔地拍拍她的背：「没关系的，我们明天继续努力，一步一步来。」咘咘安心地闭上了眼睛。
pages.text_en: Teacher Miao tiptoes over and sits beside Bubu, gently patting her back: "It's okay, we'll try again tomorrow. One step at a time." Bubu closes her eyes, feeling safe.

pages.text: 下午放学了！咘咘从教室跑出来，看见爸爸妈妈外公外婆全都来了！她张开双臂飞奔过去：「爸爸！妈妈！我回来啦！」
pages.text_en: School's out! Bubu runs out of the classroom and sees Dad, Mom, Grandpa and Grandma all waiting! She opens her arms and dashes over: "Daddy! Mommy! I'm back!"

pages.text: 回家的路上，咘咘骄傲地举起一幅画：「我今天交了新朋友！老师很好！我画了一幅画送给你们！」Coco 在旁边鼓掌：「So proud of you, Bubu!」咘咘昂起头说：「我是大小朋友了！」全家人都为她鼓掌。
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu proudly holds up a painting: "I made new friends today! Teacher is so nice! I painted this for you!" Coco claps: "So proud of you, Bubu!" Bubu lifts her chin: "I'm a big kid now!" Everyone cheers for her.
